resume.scope: Identical six-row intake, immutable producer policy, same private sparse lane heads; no new optimizer jobs on resume.

scope: Six training/two repeatedly used tuning rows; private feature candidates, no independent canary or formalization evidence. Targets were reused from a prior verified preparation; this run performs no new target generation.

shared_target_reuse.timing_scope: Original preparation is a referenced prior run, excluded from this run's training elapsed time.

waves.overlap_evidence_scope: Each completed training interval lies within the coordinator dispatch interval. Summed training time exceeding that interval proves overlap; no claim is made from process coexistence alone.
